breakfast: Sattu sharbat (2 tbsp sattu, water, lemon, salt, no sugar) + 2 boiled eggs
1 katori poha with peanuts + 1 glass milk (no sugar)
lunch: 2 roti + 1 katori dal + big bowl sabzi + salad
1 katori rice + 1 katori dal + sabzi + curd
snack: Tea (no sugar) + 1 small fistful roasted chana
dinner: 1–2 roti + 2-egg bhurji or 150 g chicken curry + sabzi
1 katori dal + big bowl sabzi + 1 roti
notes: Roti = medium phulka, no ghee. Katori = one small bowl.
Oil: 3 teaspoons for the whole day, cooking included.
Vegetarian swap: replace eggs/chicken/fish with 100 g paneer, 1 katori soya chunks, or extra dal.
Still hungry: salad, cucumber or buttermilk — never extra roti or rice.
Litti chokha once a week — baked, no ghee dip, 2 pieces.
